comparison.objective: Move a three-box stack to a shelf in one trip without separating it; candidate transfers an uncaged LM block to a jig.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests whole-stack bimanual squeezing, transport, regrasping, and balance. Candidate tests narrow end-face mating, parallelism, and force-limited constrained sliding.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires the stack never to separate, over-slide, or over-tilt and to stand released on the shelf. Candidate requires uninterrupted rail/jig support and retention of every freely moving ball through complete transfer.
comparison.reason: Preserving a frictional stack during free-space transport does not test continuous raceway support or internal rolling-element containment.
